name: Role-based branch access and permissions
description: The system must support different permissions for branch managers, cashiers, stock staff, administrators, and central operations so actions are controlled at the right level.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks who can approve actions, manage stock, or reconcile cash at branch level.
Developer asks how permissions differ between staff roles.
Developer mentions branch managers, cashiers, or admin oversight.

name: Multi-branch hierarchy and central oversight
description: The platform must support multiple retail branches with central reporting and consistent controls while allowing branch-level operational differences where needed.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about multiple branches or regional oversight.
Developer mentions branch comparison or centralized management.
Developer discusses shared controls and local variation.

name: Inventory visibility across locations
description: The system must provide stock visibility across branches, including low-stock triggers, transfer requests, and branch-specific stock movement.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about stock across branches or transfers between locations.
Developer mentions branch inventory visibility.
Developer discusses low-stock alerts or transfer planning.

name: Pricing and promotion management
description: The retailer needs a way to manage pricing rules, promotions, and markdowns consistently while still respecting local branch differences where required.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about pricing rules or promotions.
Developer mentions price changes or markdown controls.
Developer discusses variation by branch or campaign.

name: Point-of-sale and reconciliation flow
description: The system must handle sales transactions, payment types, refunds, and end-of-day reconciliation so each branch closes accurately.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks how sales are recorded and reconciled.
Developer mentions cash drawers, refunds, or daily close.
Developer discusses payment methods or branch reconciliation.

name: Branch-level reporting and KPI tracking
description: The company needs dashboards and reports for sales, stock movement, margin, and branch performance to support operational decisions.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about dashboards, sales trends, or branch performance.
Developer mentions stock movement or margin analysis.
Developer discusses KPI reporting across locations.

name: Supplier and purchasing coordination
description: The business needs supplier records, purchase orders, and reorder planning so branches can stay stocked without excess waste or delays.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about suppliers, purchase orders, or restocking.
Developer mentions reorder triggers or supplier cost control.
Developer discusses branch purchasing coordination.

name: Staffing and training complexity
description: The system must fit the realities of a growing multi-branch retail operation, including branch-specific staff availability, training burden, and adoption issues.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about staff onboarding or branch training.
Developer mentions adoption problems or process consistency.
Developer discusses operational constraints in a multi-site environment.

name: System integration with current retail tools
description: The business likely has existing POS, accounting, or ERP tools that must connect cleanly with the new system to avoid duplicate work and operational breaks.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about integration with accounting or POS tools.
Developer mentions existing systems or data migration.
Developer discusses compatibility and operational handoffs.

name: Customer and loyalty retention workflow
description: The business may need customer records and loyalty tracking to support repeat shopping and targeted offers without disrupting branch operations.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about customer records, repeat purchases, or loyalty.
Developer mentions offers or retention.
Developer discusses customer visibility across the group.
